html:
Question 11
?

The function x(t) models the number of meters traveled by a car, t seconds after it sets off on a journey. What is the best interpretation of x′(30)=10?

a
30 seconds after the start of the journey, the distance traveled decreased at a rate of 10 meters per second
b
The distance traveled increased at a constant rate of 3 meters per second
c
The distance traveled increased by 10 meters during the first 30 seconds
d
30 seconds after the start of the journey, the car traveled 10 meters.
e
30 seconds after the start of the journey, the distance traveled increased at a rate of 10 meters per second
Submit
